name: Cil Securities Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1989, CIL Securities Ltd isin the business of Stock Broking and other Capital Market activities[1]
keyPoints:
Services Offered:
a) Securities Trading:[1]
Company is a Corporate Member of NSE in the Capital Market Segment, Future and Option Segment & in Currency Derivative Segment and also is a Member of BSE. It provides trading through Mobile, Web & Application Based, Call & Trade
b) Equity Research Cell:[2]
Company undertakes continuous research, studies and identifies companies with growth potential and selects them for its own investment portfolio and also makes recommendations to its clients. The division brings out a periodical newsletter called CILEQISEARCH
c) Merchant Banking:[3]
Company is a category – I Merchant Banker registered with SEBI MBD. It assists in Company formation to project financing and successful planning and execution of the Public Issue. It also does corporate advisory services, Project counseling, Managing Takeover offers, etc.
d) Registrar & Share Transfer Agents:[4]
Company is a SEBI Registered Category-I Registrar & Share Transfer Agent. It does Registrars Activities for new issues and handles share transfer works for physical and dematerialized shares
e) Depository Participant:[5]
Company is a SEBI Registered Depository Participant for CDSL maintaining and serving large no. of Corporate/ Individual Beneficiary Owners

pros: Stock is trading at 0.75 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 9.02% over last 3 years.
